owns: Owner-observed Plaid account_id to Atlas canonical-id mapping for this machine only. Copy to plaid-account-map.local.json and fill the real Plaid account_id values. That local file is gitignored. In production the same document travels as the ATLAS_PLAID_ACCOUNT_MAP_JSON secret.
does_not_own: Financial values, permission to write data.json, automatic account creation, Forecast, Lunch Money provider ids, or synthetic fixture IDs.
notes: Identity is the stable Plaid account_id, never the display name, mask, or official_name.
Same atlas-provider-account-map/v1 schema as the Lunch Money map; only the provider and the ids differ. One mapping authority, two provider documents.
Mapping does not authorize a canonical write. Plaid balance observations are not consumed by live-plan.js; Lunch Money remains the incumbent live provider.
All three required household-cash identities (chequing-a, chequing-b, savings) must be mapped, or live observation fails closed before any request.
Map any non-household account the Item returns as atlasRole household-external rather than leaving it unmapped.
